_note: research-loop.json holds two kinds of entries: repo-bound paths and host command templates (rl init asks gyb for those marked init_asks), and thresholds with defaults. There is no per-ledger path key (08 L18, L40).

keys.what: artifact root for experiment outputs and raw data; new1 points at the net disk
analysis artifact root for large files; small figures and notebooks stay in analysis/
the host's slow-variable file, new1: ops/gpu_state.md
GPU probe command template, new1: run.py gpu-jobs free
launch command template, new1: run.py launch
host finish command template, new1: run.py record finish
host abort command template used by the 'host deregister' step of the abort sequence, new1: run.py gpu-jobs finish; empty means the step is skipped
how this repo runs: three fixed fields env, entry, notes, each natural language or a command, not parsed by the machine
list of host ledger files, each {path, note, kind}; only the host runs ledger has kind runs (doctor uses it); roles never touch these files
write-hook path allowlist: listed paths are allowed whatever they resolve to; gyb fills it after rl init

launcher_empty_means_skip.text: An empty launcher.* template means the host has no such step; rl skips it without error and rl init lists which are empty.

thresholds.used: stall line = 5 x typical heartbeat interval (from ops/verdicts.py)
stall line lower bound of three samples
no stall verdict in the first 30 minutes
GPU utilisation at zero for 15 minutes counts as one piece of evidence
rl status section 2 marks issues idle beyond 24 hours
doctor item 11: answered and not closed for 3 days
rl status section 7: holder session silent for 30 minutes
a session that wrote nothing for 48 hours counts as idle
an order with no transition for 72 hours counts as idle
a quick lane open for 7 days is listed by reclaim
a metric landing on 0 or 1 raises an anomaly warning in rl run finish
actual duration beyond 3 x estimate raises an anomaly warning in rl run finish
rl status lists review checklists of the last 7 days
how long to wait for the file lock before exit 4
where quick-lane worktrees are created; branch and directory both named by ql_tag

removed_keys.why: periodic reminders are not built in this version (01 L145-147; sync-inbox Q40)
